canDo: Describe an animal: what it has got and what colour it is
Say what an animal can and can't do
grammar: Is it a ...? Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

chunks.example: It can swim. It can't fly.
Is it a frog? Yes, it is!
My favourite animal is the octopus.

talkMissions.title: Guess the animal
talkMissions.goal: Guessing game. Pip describes an animal with 'It's got / It can / It lives in' and the child guesses with 'Is it a ...?'. Then swap: the child describes, Pip guesses (Pip guesses wrong once on purpose so the child must add a clue).
talkMissions.opener: Let's play a game! I think of an animal. It's got eight legs. It lives in the sea. Is it a cat? No! Can you guess?

talkMissions.title: Super animals
talkMissions.goal: Talk about what animals can and can't do. Pip is amazed by Earth animals (on Zoot no animal can swim). Child says what 3 animals can/can't do and what she can do.
talkMissions.opener: On Zoot, animals can't swim. Water is very strange for us! Which Earth animals can swim?
hints: A duck can swim and fly.

talkMissions.title: My new animal
talkMissions.goal: Child invents and describes a new animal (from her animal card drawing): name, colour, body parts, what it can do, where it lives. Pip asks curious questions to make descriptions longer.
talkMissions.opener: You are a great artist! Can you make a new animal for me? What's its name?

letters.subject: A strange animal!
letters.body:
Dear friend,
Today I am at the sea. I can see a very strange animal! It's got eight long legs. It hasn't got a tail. It can change colour! It is very clever. What is it? I think it is an octopus. Is it? Can you tell me your favourite sea animal?
Pip 🦊
letters.replyPrompt: Answer Pip: Is it an octopus? What is your favourite sea animal? What has it got?
letters.replyPromptTr: Pip'e cevap ver: Bu bir ahtapot mu? En sevdiğin deniz hayvanı ne? Nesi var?

questions.q: How many legs has the animal got?

letters.subject: Night bird
letters.body:
Dear friend,
It is night and I can't sleep. I look at a tree. Two big yellow eyes are looking at me! It is a bird. It's got big eyes and soft wings. It says "hoo hoo". It can fly at night. It lives in the forest. My friend says it is an owl. Do you like owls?
Pip 🦊
letters.replyPrompt: Tell Pip: Do you like owls? Which animal can you hear at night?
letters.replyPromptTr: Pip'e yaz: Baykuşları sever misin? Geceleri hangi hayvanı duyabilirsin?

questions.q: What colour are the owl's eyes?

letters.subject: At the farm
letters.body:
Dear friend,
Today I am at a farm. There are sheep, ducks and a big dog. The sheep are white and soft. The ducks can swim in the pond. The dog can run very fast. But it can't climb trees. I can climb trees! What can you do? Can you swim? Can you climb?
Pip 🦊
letters.replyPrompt: Tell Pip three things you can do and one thing you can't do.
letters.replyPromptTr: Pip'e yapabildiğin üç şeyi ve yapamadığın bir şeyi yaz.

story.title: My new animal
story.prompt: Invent a new animal. Draw it and make its animal card.
story.promptTr: Yeni bir hayvan uydur. Onu çiz ve hayvan kartını hazırla.

pages.prompt: Draw your new animal. What's its name? What colour is it?
pages.promptTr: Yeni hayvanını çiz. Adı ne? Ne renk?

pages.prompt: What has it got? What can it do?
Where does it live? What does it eat?

explorer.title: Octopuses
explorer.text: An octopus lives in the sea. It has got eight arms. It hasn't got any bones, so it can go into very small holes! An octopus can change colour. It can be red, brown or white. It can hide on rocks. An octopus is very clever. It can open a jar!
facts: An octopus has got eight arms.

questions.q: How many arms has it got?
Why can it go into small holes?

explorer.title: Owls
explorer.text: Owls are birds. They have got big eyes and soft feathers. Owls can see very well at night. They can turn their heads a long way round! Owls can fly with no sound. They sleep in the day and hunt at night. Many owls live in forests. They eat mice and insects.
facts: They can turn their heads a long way.
